issues.description: The exercise/project name identifier is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement titles the task as "H02E02 - Panic at Seal Saloon" (problem_statement.md), while the provided template and solution repositories set the Gradle project name to 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House' and 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House-Solution' respectively (settings.gradle). This mismatch can confuse students about which exercise they are working on and whether the repository matches the described problem, increasing extraneous cognitive load when mapping the problem statement to the codebase.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the exercise/project identifier consistent across all artifacts. For example, set the Gradle rootProject.name in both template and solution settings.gradle files to match the problem statement title, e.g. rootProject.name = 'H02E02 - Panic at Seal Saloon', or alternatively update the problem_statement.md title to match the repository name if the repository name is correct. Ensure the same identifier is used in documentation and repository configuration.
